summary: The Divine Forge is the molten heart of Underfoot, where Brell Serilis shapes stone, metal, and crystal into divine creations. Mortals who enter this sacred place confront living constructs born of Brell’s craftsmanship.
history: The Divine Forge was the first workshop created by Brell Serilis.
Stone guardians and crystal constructs were forged here.
The Divine Smith oversees the forge in Brell’s absence.
Magma rivers were shaped into divine channels to power the furnaces.
